question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Liability
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Asset'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Liability" **refers to a legal or financial obligation or responsibility.(दायित्व)
 
• **Asset:** This word represents something of value or advantage that is owned or possessed.(संपत्ति)
 
• The most **appropriate antonym** of the word** "Liability"** is **"Asset."**

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Asset'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Resource: **This word refers to a source or supply that can be drawn upon to accomplish a task or achieve a goal. (संसाधन)
 
• **Responsibility: **This word refers to the state or duty of being accountable for something, often implying an obligation to fulfill certain tasks or duties.(जिम्मेदारी )
 
 
• While "Responsibility" is related to accountability, it does not directly represent the opposite meaning of "Liability."
 
 
 
• **Strike: **This word refers to a work stoppage or a collective action by workers to protest or demand certain conditions.(हड़ताल )
